title: Stainless Steel Cat Water Fountain - 74oz/2.2L Cat Drinking Fountain
say: Customers find the water fountain functional and appreciate that their pets love it, with one noting their cats took to it right away. The fountain operates quietly with a soothing sound, is simple to clean, and features a soft blue glow that helps see water levels easily at night. While some customers say it's more than worth the price, others consider it a waste of money, and durability is a concern as the pump stops working after about a year and a half.
